keys.responses: rows of response_unit for this series (one per index), in column order
keys.predictions: rows of prediction_series for this series (one per method and scenario), in column order
keys.windows: rows of season_windows for the horizon harvest years, in column order
keys.weather: rows of weather_todate_anomaly for this series (one per product), with the product's metrics as [value, reference, anom, z, pct_rank, n_years]
